title: holdout-validation input contract
description: Input contract for the holdout-validation skill. The skill receives self-review findings from the code-reviewer agent (or equivalent), the evidence bundle draft assembled so far, and the list of files modified on the branch. It cross-references the agent's claims against the actual file state using hidden holdout scenarios. See plugins/flow/skills/holdout-validation/SKILL.md for the skill's full process; this schema is the machine-checkable shape of its inputs.

selfReviewFindings.description: P1/P2/P3 findings from the self-review pass — what the agent claims about the implementation. Each finding follows the canonical 6-field shape from references/finding-schema.md.

id.description: Stable identifier (e.g. F1, SEC-1). Must match the canonical ID grammar.

evidenceBundle.description: Per-criterion evidence collected so far during VERIFY phase. Each entry corresponds to one acceptance criterion. Full bundle shape is documented in references/evidence-bundle-format.md; this schema captures the minimum input contract.

fileList.description: Paths to all files modified or created on the branch. The skill reads these to verify self-review claims against actual file state.
